dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi! I’m looking for a pair of shoes that I can use for more formal occasions, but I’m also on a bit of a budget—something under $50 would be ideal. Comfort and durability are important to me, too. Do you have any options that might fit what I’m looking for?
dialogue.agent:
Here are some formal shoes under $50 that emphasize comfort and durability:

- **Anne Klein Womens Oalise** — $35.48, 4.4 stars (141 reviews). Synthetic upper and lining for durability, low kitten heel, flexible/durable outsole, cushioned for comfort. Sleek, pointed toe design suitable for formal occasions.

- **Faranzi mens Moccasin,boat Shoes,loafers** — $36.99, 3.8 stars (3 reviews). Hand-brushed PU, cushioned insole for comfort/shock absorption, lightweight, flexible, suitable for formal and casual events.

Is either of these styles appealing, or would you like more details or options?

products.title: Anne Klein Womens Oalise
products.description: The Anne Klein Oalise is a classic and sophisticated shoe that offers fashion-forward design and luxury. The shoe features the Anne Klein branding, adding a touch of luxury to your everyday look. The Oalise is available in a variety of colors, making it easy to match any outfit. The shoe is made with a synthetic upper and lining for durability and easy maintenance. The flexible and durable outsole provides added comfort and support. The pointed toe design gives the shoe a sleek look, perfect for both casual and formal occasions. The low kitten heel ensures added comfort and ease of wear, making it perfect for all-day wear. The shoe is easy to slip on and off, making it perfect for quick and convenient wear. The Oalise is available in both medium and wide widths, accommodating various foot sizes. The affordable price point makes it a great value purchase that you will love to wear every day. The timeless and versatile design of the Oalise makes it a perfect addition to any wardrobe. AK Anne Klein offers an impressive footwear collection offering unparalleled variety in an extensive range of sizes, colors, and styles that give each shoe a unique style and character. AK Anne Klein footwear provides fashion, quality, and comfort at an affordable price point that's perfect for every modern woman's lifestyle.

top_reviews.title: Great for skinny feet and comfort
top_reviews.text: Ok. LOVE this shoe. Super cozy, extra cushion AND stylish. Some reviews said to go up a size because they are narrow in the toe, but I have skinny and flat feet and my “normal” shoe size is a perfect fit.

top_reviews.title: Loyal Anne Klein shoe buyer
top_reviews.text: Anne Klein does it right every time. I can order online because it always has the same fit. These shoes are super comfortable and look really nice. I’ve tried many other brands for my work shoes and Anne is the only one who gets me, comfy and stylish and never a need to “break in” her shoes.

top_reviews.title: Disappointed
top_reviews.text: I am amazed to see how much the quality of Anne Klein products have deteriorated! I bought two pairs of AK shoes. Surprised to see that that the shoes had hardly any friction on the  soles!!! Getting things made in China is not serving the customers but definitely stuffing the pockets of higher level management and owners. The shoes run small. The sole is thin smooth piece of plastic.. Poor quality and watch out very slippery even on dry hard wood floor or ceramic tiles. Personally I will look for higher end shoes that are made in Europe or USA, may be pricy but will be reliable, safe, and worth the money.
